name: @laticent/filo
description: One undo history for every way a document changes. Every writer (an editor, a settings panel, an AI action, a drag) commits a change to one history per document; Filo stores each as a reversible patch and hands back the one change to apply on undo or redo. Coalesced typing, batches, drag groups, marks with restore, stale-commit refusal, outside-change gap steps, and step and byte caps. Text only, zero dependencies.
author: Sharmarke Aden (Laticent) <sharmarke.aden@gmail.com>
